mapper.select: select i_no, i_type, i_title, i_search, i_reply, i_email, i_tel, i_name, i_memo, i_file, i_define, i_img, p_no from tea_inquiry order by i_no desc
select i_no, i_type, i_title, i_search, i_reply, i_email, i_tel, i_name, i_memo, i_file, i_define, i_img, p_no from tea_inquiry where i_no = #{i_no}
mapper.insert: insert into tea_inquiry (i_no, i_type, i_title, i_search, i_reply, i_email, i_tel, i_name, i_memo, i_file, i_define, i_img, p_no) values (#{i_no}, #{i_type}, #{i_title}, #{i_search}, #{i_reply}, #{i_email}, #{i_tel}, #{i_name}, #{i_memo}, #{i_file}, #{i_define}, #{i_img}, #{p_no})
mapper.update: update tea_inquiry set i_type = #{i_type}, i_title = #{i_title}, i_search = #{i_search}, i_reply = #{i_reply}, i_email = #{i_email}, i_tel = #{i_tel}, i_name = #{i_name}, i_memo = #{i_memo}, i_file = #{i_file}, i_define = #{i_define}, i_img = #{i_img} where i_no = #{i_no}
